title: Bad Bunny and Gabriela Berlingeri Spotted Together at Wimbledon, Fueling Reconciliation Speculation
detail: Two days after his Tottenham residency finale, Bad Bunny attends Novak Djokovic's Wimbledon first-round win over Wu Yibing (June 29, 2026) alongside longtime on-and-off partner Gabriela Berlingeri, a Puerto Rican jewelry designer. Seated together in the stands — not in the player's box — the pair chatted and applauded throughout the match, with Bad Bunny in a dark hoodie, white T-shirt, cap, and sunglasses. The rare joint public outing, following Djokovic's own cameo at Bad Bunny's Tottenham show two days earlier, sparked renewed media speculation that the couple — known for guarding their relationship from the public eye — have rekindled their romance.
